paragraphs: He is mentioned in the Zohar several times, in the phrase “it is written in the book of R' Yeisa Saba,” as in Bereshit 32b, 34b, 79b, and in several other places.[^1][^2]

notes.text: לב:/לד:/עט: give 32b/34b/79b by applying colon-as-b to Zohar folios; Bereshit is read as its named section. Neither interpretation is newly verified against a named edition.

Supplied ייסא differs from earlier audit יוסא; Yeisa is provisional transliteration and inherited heading status remains unresolved. Saba is elder, retained transliterated. Both personal titles remain R'; no author identity follows from book-of wording.
